name: sunny-kestrel-independent-stop-ownership-g0

stop_policy.latch: Irreversible per-run NO_NEW_ADMISSION and invalidation of every active or committed-body-but-not-final candidate before cleanup.
stop_policy.clock: Monotonic absolute deadlines fixed when halt latches, not reset by retry, body progress, writer state or Abort.
stop_policy.external: Control available even with all Kestrel/listener/recovery and evidence-writer workers saturated; no HTTP API dependency.
stop_policy.cleanup: Observe transport read/write tasks, callbacks, collateral connection contexts and pooled buffer last access; no release until completed.
stop_policy.unresolved: If stop deadline missed or provenance missing, finish UNRESOLVED_QUARANTINED, not QUIESCENT_EVIDENCED.
stop_policy.escalation: Finite external process-level stop may be considered only under future explicit approval; process exit is a stop, not proof of per-request cleanup.
stop_policy.restart: Manual rollback plus new explicit operator approval before every fresh run; no in-place re-arm.

owned_resources.required_obligation: Stop must be available outside Kestrel, HTTP request pipeline, worker pool and evidence writer; no selected executable/port, operator yet.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Separate explicit operator identity, external stop control availability and observed invocation/exit with final deadline.

owned_resources.required_obligation: Stop future synthetic writes on halt; never target installed Sunny or any existing service.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Per-connection written bytes, pending writes, stopped traffic and approved endpoint inventory.
owned_resources.on_unresolved: BLOCK; halt and quarantine unknown synthetic sends

owned_resources.required_obligation: Own listener lifetime, accepted connection list, shutdown and external termination collateral distinct from connection abort.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Bound process and accepted-connection inventory, actual terminal event, bound endpoints unbound and no global OS mutation.
owned_resources.on_unresolved: BLOCK; process exit alone not per-request cleanup

owned_resources.required_obligation: Track body ReadAsync owner and every terminal/canceled-but-pending continuation with epoch/alias.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Task completion observed for each pending and collateral request; cancellation signal alone insufficient.
owned_resources.on_unresolved: BLOCK; retain pending capacity and quarantine buffers

owned_resources.required_obligation: Track response output, headers including 100-continue and late callbacks after disconnect/abort.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Write task terminal with correlated request ID, buffer last-access evidence and no private output.

owned_resources.required_obligation: Every pooled buffer, reference and lease has a last-access owner before any safe release.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Verified final access excluded, owner quiescent, safe release or recorded unresolved quarantine.
owned_resources.on_unresolved: BLOCK; do not return to pool/reuse capacity

owned_resources.required_obligation: Observer/evidence writer may fail or block and must not be required to invoke emergency stop.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Independent observation source, loss-of-evidence marker and fallback trace without private data.
owned_resources.on_unresolved: BLOCK for incomplete evidence; stop still works

owned_resources.required_obligation: Exact disposable executable, endpoint inventory, OS changes and leftover tasks reconciled before any later run.
owned_resources.required_terminal_evidence: Reviewed rollback record, remaining quarantine, independent explicit new run consent; never auto restart.

contract_warning: Design only; flags and fields are not proof of real task quiescence, an actual abort API, Windows behavior, or operator authorization.
